responsibility: Provides the generated documentation-link mapping for M32R target command-line options declared in m32r.opt. This auxiliary backend metadata file records the Texinfo/HTML anchor suffixes associated with each supported M32R-specific switch so GCC’s option-documentation machinery can connect parsed options such as CPU selection, loop alignment, debug, and cache-flush flags to the correct manual entries; unlike m32r.opt it contains no option semantics, only per-option URL references, with omissions left for options that have no discovered manual anchor.
